text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Last time, I was bewildered by the storm,
and
struggled to showcase my true
strength...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But I've been training hard to make sure
things go
differently this time.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Nothing is stronger than the winds
that blow
back after the storm.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm sure you can win.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I will win this race, without fail!
